results.title: Pueblo Boulevard roadway project gets the green light
results.description: (PUEBLO, Colo.) — Over one million dollars from Pueblo's 'half-cent sales tax fund' was voted to become the primary source of funding to complete the Pueblo Boulevard roadway on Monday, Nov. 9.
